assessment.expected_relation: After processing write processed-record count to local count.txt. Count demand does not require whole records or tokens. Do not substitute total input count for processed count without evidence.

candidate_assessment.reason: Real receiving demands exist. Global/source limits and conservative accounting prevent actionable minimality/DOE conclusions.
